originality.rationale: The claim is the new finite-state off-diagonal, low-step stochasticity phase law and its expected negative transition. The scheme and high-step scalar branch are explicitly prior. Comparison with same-tableau two-state and scalar results, same-chain different-scheme full texts, and general absolute-monotonicity theory does not imply this new precise five-state classification. Specialist historical priority is qualified, not certified.
residual_risks: Historical priority cannot be proven from semantic searches; unindexed RK positivity computations might contain a mathematically equivalent special case.
Full text of Horváth (1998) was not obtained; only abstract-level implications were compared.
The step-h>2 scalar sign branch is already published and is presented only as a necessary component of the complete phase law, not an independent novel theorem.

value.rationale: Row-stochasticity is an essential physical invariance of Markov semigroup discretization. The finding establishes a full exact probability diagram on the first birth-chain dimension showing small-step failure, identifies a noninterval all-draw safe set, and proves failure of ensemble averaging to restore entrywise positivity. This addresses a structural method-selection question rather than a routine test of scalar A-stability.
